answer: As honest work compounds, the rising tide of earned trust raises the cost of forking fresh identities, since attackers must repeat staking and attestation cycles, making mass fake accounts economically unviable. To mitigate sybils, each agent must lock a stake in the vault; new identities join a waiting spiral where reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over several epochs. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
